questions.q: The product demonstration was so ______ that nobody left early.
questions.exp: 主詞是產品示範（事情），事情讓人覺得有趣用 -ing：interesting。interested 是人覺得有興趣。

questions.q: Many visitors were ______ by the signs in the new building.
questions.exp: 主詞是訪客（人），by 帶出讓他們糊塗的東西：人覺得糊塗用 -ed，confused by。

questions.q: Please review the ______ document before tomorrow's meeting.
questions.exp: 文件是被附在信裡的，被動，用過去分詞 attached：the attached document（附件）。

questions.q: The engineer ______ the new ordering system will give a demonstration on Monday.
questions.exp: 工程師在設計系統，主動，後面有受詞：the engineer designing…＝the engineer who is designing。主要動詞是 will give，空格不能再放有時態的動詞。

questions.q: ______ in a quiet neighborhood, the hotel is popular with business travelers.
questions.exp: 飯店是「被設在」安靜的地區，被動，用過去分詞 Located；分詞的主詞就是逗號後面的 the hotel。

questions.q: ______ the report, Ms. Lin sent it to the director for approval.
questions.exp: 林小姐先寫完報告、再寄給主管：主動、先完成，用 having＋過去分詞。Finished、Having been finished 是被動，會變成林小姐被完成。

opts: Reviewing the contract, the manager found two errors.
Reviewing the contract, two errors were found.
Reviewed the contract, the manager found two errors.
Having reviewed the contract, two errors were found by the manager.
questions.exp: 分詞的主詞要等於逗號後面的主詞：審合約的是經理，所以主詞要是 the manager。two errors 不會審合約；Reviewed 是被動，經理不是被審的。

questions.q: All items ______ in the spring catalog are available for next-day delivery.
questions.exp: 商品是被列在目錄裡的，被動：items listed＝items which are listed。主要動詞是 are。

questions.q: ______ the heavy rain, the outdoor concert was moved indoors.
questions.exp: Given 當介系詞，意思是「考慮到」：Given the heavy rain（考慮到大雨）。它是介系詞，不用跟主詞 the concert 對上。

questions.q: The room rate is $180 per night, breakfast ______.
questions.exp: 放在名詞 breakfast 後面，表示「早餐包括在內」，用 included；including 是介系詞，要放在被包括的東西前面（including breakfast）。
